newSources.title: Lancelin — Beach & Offshore Coast
newSources.story: Look over Lancelin beach and offshore water from the Marine Rescue camera. The reviewed still shows a pale sandy shoreline with seaweed, blue water, boats and low offshore land; the inland sand dunes are outside this view. Check the capture time and separate beach or marine notices before a visit. A camera image cannot establish swimming or boating safety, dune access, equipment availability or tour operation.
